en: Black‑and‑white view over a European town square or park, with a broad unpaved street in the foreground. On the left stands an ornate multi‑storey corner building with a mansard roof, dormer windows and a small cupola; in front of it is a decorative metal streetlight and a sign on the lamppost. In the center of the image, within a landscaped park filled with trees and shrubs, is a large equestrian statue on a pedestal. To the right are several richly decorated late‑19th‑century apartment houses with gabled roofs. In the distant background, on a hill, are more town buildings and a church with a tall baroque tower and onion‑shaped dome. The overall style and clothing of a few pedestrians suggest an early‑20th‑century Central European city.
